reviews.text:
I cannot speak highly enough of KIBA K9s and their trainer, Tiffany. We adopted an incredibly sweet 7 month old rescue who came to us with a lot of fear of the outdoors and loud vehicles. Walking in the city was very difficult and at first we were having trouble even making it around the block.

Through our private sessions, Tiffany was able to show us how to better communicate with him, build his confidence and reinforce positive behaviors. The change has truly been incredible. We are now able to take him around the neighborhood and to parks every day and he has made so much progress.

Tiffany was also fantastic at helping us establish a consistent training routine and showing us ways to continue expanding his training and commands at home. As new dog owners, her guidance was invaluable and really set us up for success as we continue training and bonding with our puppy.

We are incredibly grateful for everything Tiffany has done for us and would highly recommend her and KIBA  to anyone looking for a trainer.

Kiba and team were amazing in helping us improve on-leash behaviors with our 4 year old sheepadoodle. We put our dog Sunny in a week of training where they worked with her independently everyday to improve her trouble behaviors including pulling while on leash, jumping, and impulse control. Tiffany was incredible in establishing the behavioral improvements with Sunny and then including us in private lessons to teach us how to enforce these new behaviors. We saw a noticeable improvement in Sunny’s behaviors at the of her training and felt confident we could keep these behaviors up with the training they provided my husband and I. Thanks Tiffany and Kiba!

I got Maxi as a 15 week old rescue and took her to Kiba and Tiffany right away for private training puppy steps and then continued with day training. Being a puppy, she was excited about everything and I really wanted to make sure I was setting her up well from the beginning. I’m so glad I found them when I did because she’s learned so much- proper leash manners, how to play appropriately, how to deal with distractions, settle, and be more neutral and confident out in public.

Kiba and Tiffany are both super thorough and really take the time to explain everything they’re doing and, more importantly, how you can continue it at home and in everyday life.

They genuinely care about the dogs they work with and I’d recommend them to anyone, especially if you want to give your dog the skills and confidence to have as much freedom as possible and enjoy life with them.

Tiffany is a pro!  She worked with me and my French Bulldog puppy, Gus, to reduce resource guarding and aggression. I was so overwhelmed when I first came to Tiffy with these issues but she proved to be a calming presence and a real expert at dealing with these behaviors. I’m pleased to say that I’ve seen a marked improvement in Gus since working with Tiffany!

We cannot say enough amazing things about Kiba and Tiffany. We brought our five-month-old miniature dachshund, Mac, to them needing help with foundational puppy training. Mac was fearful of going on walks outside, which made even simple outings stressful for him and for us.
Kiba and Tiffany were patient, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to understand Mac’s personality and worked with him at a great pace. The transformation has been incredible. Mac now walks confidently outside without fear, and he has a solid foundation of skills that have made him such a joy to be around. If you’re looking for trainers who genuinely care about your dog’s well-being and want lasting results, we highly recommend their training program. We are so grateful for everything they’ve done for our little guy!

It’s hard to overstate the terrific job done by Tiffany at KIBA K9. Our golden retriever, although kind and loving, had difficulty complying with some basic commands and also had a tendency to jump on and overwhelm people. Tiffany’s gentle but skillful interventions with our dog and us as well were invaluable. Our dog is now able to greet people by sitting down calmly in front of them and reliably responds to recall and other commands. Tiffany is a talented trainer  and we would highly recommend KIBA K9 to everyone

I recently adopted a dog through Korean K9 Rescue and they put me in touch with KIBA K9 to help with my new rescue, Toyo. He’s my first rescue so I definitely knew I needed guidance. Tiffany was our trainer and I’m so grateful for the time she spent with us. She was patient, knowledgeable and really helped us understand each other better. I went into the training thinking Toyo had a lot to learn, but turns out I was the one who needed the help. I would absolutely recommend their services if anyone’s a new dog owner or is looking to better connect with their dog.

Kiba and Tiffany were the best investment we made with our little 5 month old Aussie Shepard. I mean the training was more for us as new dog parents and we couldnt have asked for a better team to help us navigate. Thank you again guys for taking such good care of us and Wanda.

If you are looking for an amazing trainer who cares about how the puppy feels and checks in with you regularly, i cannot recommend Kiba enough.

Tiffany has been amazing in helping us with Oliver, our 2-year-old rescue dog. She quickly understood his personality, our challenges, and gave us practical tools that actually worked in daily life.

What we especially appreciated was how calm, patient, and clear she was — not only with Oliver, but also with us. Her guidance made training feel manageable and consistent, and we saw real improvement in his behavior and confidence.

As rescue dog owners, it was important for us to work with someone who understands sensitivity, adjustment, and trust-building, and Tiffany really does. We highly recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, thoughtful, and effective dog trainer. 🐾✨
Kirubell is a great trainer who has significantly helped me understand the concepts and fundamentals of dog training and communication with my dog.

We highly recommend the KIBA K9s team.

We adopted our five-year-old dog last year. From the beginning, he was a bit insecure, and it took a few months to settle him in his new home. Then he got too settled. He retreated to his crate and guarded it, and we could no longer leash him for his walk because he would growl.

Kirubell gave us in-home private training, and from the second he encountered Swan, we knew we made a good decision. He trained Swan and us. We also invested in board-and-train, during which Tiffany worked with him as well. Swan now runs to put his head through the leash on the “leash up” command, among other learned behaviors, including no anxiety when we have visitors.

I can't say enough about this team.

We loved Tiffany from KIBA K9s! Our dog, Moka, struggled with reactivity towards other dogs when walking. With Tiffany, we were able to learn and use new commands that helped build a language and connection between us and Moka. Although Moka is still working on her behaviors, we realized our consistency and time in training/playing with Moka has changed everything (even if it's 10 minutes in the morning, 10 minutes in the evening). Tiffany listened to our concerns and provided realistic solutions fit for our lives. She also was able to provide home sessions. We are super thankful and know we'll be back if we ever needed a booster session!

We found Kirubell and Tiffany through our neighborhood park--Nash, one of the regular dogs in the morning, is a large dog and was incredibly well behaved around our then 3 month old rescue pup, Oona. When we decided we wanted to work with a trainer, we asked Nash's dad who they worked with. We're so glad we found Kiba and went through their puppy steps training! Kiba and Tiff helped us train Oona through basic obedience with communication markers, but also leash walking, the importance of play, and recall with an e-collar. Each session was kind of organic, based on what our priorities were. Would also highly recommend boarding your pup with them, since the board and train only reinforces everything. Definitely an investment, but so worth it.

Thank goodness for Kiba K9s! We were looking for a local trainer, and we hit the jackpot (right around the corner, no less). We started working with Tiffany in March when our puppy was little. She taught us a lot about how to effectively communicate with our dog, and how to encourage confidence in addition to listening. In no time our pup could sit, lie down, stand up, play fetch, be directed to go over/under/up on/down off things, and he always waits for his food til we give him the go ahead.  Now Vincent is 14 months old, and his recall is great! We can trust him off-leash in parks. We're planning more sessions soon to keep adding skills now that he's older.

We got to work with Tiffany, who was a wonderful coach & trainer. She was so patient with both us and our rescue pup Frankie. We didn't know anything about Frankie's history prior to finding her, and Tiffany really worked with us based on our schedule & how Frankie was responding to training. We feel so much better equipped moving forward after our work with Tiffany!
We have had a great experience with Tiffany and Kiba, doing training sessions and boarding for our rescue dog Neptune. They helped with Neptune’s reactivity and guided us to support him better.

You would think it'll be easy to find good trainers in New York City but unfortunately they are few and far between. With that said, I hope you find KIBA K9 early in your search. That will save you a ton of headaches.

I’ve enrolled in puppy steps private sessions. Our goal was to develop my German shepherd to thrive in any environment. We want him to be able to focus  under distractions at the handler and build him up to not create fearful or reactive behavior. He has helped me immensely build a communication system with my puppy and build a good foundation to survive the busy streets of NYC.

So whether you are dealing with reactive aggressive dog, want your dog to stop pulling you on the leash, or just want to do cool things with your dog, I recommend you check out KIBA K9s.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer and you’ve come across Kiba K9s, look no further! For some background, Dora is a rescue and in the beginning, she was an incredibly anxious and shy dog. One thing I struggled with the most was navigating her extreme fear of going outside. Trying to train her myself was impossible and desperate for help, I reached out to Kiba K9s and wow it was the best thing I could’ve done for both me and Dora. Working with Tiffany has been an absolute dream and lifesaver. We did a few private sessions together and by the end of it, Dora was a completely different dog and I was blown away by how much progress Dora made in such a short amount of time. Tiffany was sooo patient, knowledgeable and compassionate. Not only did she help train Dora, but I feel like she trained me as well!

After finishing our private sessions, I was so pleased with the results that I enrolled Dora in the Day Training program where she continues to make progress even quicker. I’ve worked with other trainers in the past with my previous dog and no one even compares to the level of expertise that Tiffany and Kiba have. Couldn’t recommend them more!

I adopted my 8 year old rescue pup Mickey over the summer and very quickly realized that while he’s sweet and smart, he hadn’t really been trained before and had some leash reactivity issues. I worked with Tiffany over several sessions and she was so immensely helpful with figuring out what he would and would not respond to, providing us with a base of foundations, and working to help address our better walking goals. The difference from before training and after is night and day! I feel like I now better understand how to communicate with Mickey and we have a stronger bond to show for it. I highly recommend Tiffany and the KIBA K9 team for dog training, even if you have an older pup and you’re not sure!

We had such a great experience training with Tiffany! Our biggest concerns were our dog’s reactivity to other animals and his obedience, and he's has greatly improved! His reactivity toward other dogs has almost completely changed and he’s much calmer around rats/squirrels.

Tiffany taught us different leash handling techniques and introduced tools that helped him stay focused and connected with us. We feel far more confident leading him in different situations.

You can tell Tiffany really loves what she does. She’s easy to talk to and genuinely cares about helping you and your dog reach your goals.
